name: Tari L. Cody
office: Presiding Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Six

items.text: Tari L. Cody became Presiding Justice of the Second District Court of Appeal, Division Six, in 2026, after serving as an associate justice since 2023. She previously served on the Ventura County Superior Court for 22 years. On the appellate court, she wrote opinions applying the primary assumption of risk doctrine to surfing and rejecting Second Amendment challenges to certain state firearm restrictions.
